title: Science
textContentHtml:
1. Quantum computer: (Simulate qubits in the digital world)

2. It all started with the creation of a new material (NAME IT)

   a. A material with a very small switches. (Transistors)

   b. When the moores law was not applied anymore. This material was created which basically redefined the moores law and now we are able to create millions of cubits within a very small device.
